name: Cabanas & Marceline Market Classic Golden Mickey Mouse Waffles (Standalone)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Cabanas / Disney Treasure · Marceline Market
whyItWorks: Light, airy refined-flour Mickey Mouse waffles with zero seeds or roughage—an iconic, easily digested DCL morning staple.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Enjoy warm with a light drizzle of maple syrup or honey and scrambled eggs; skip the seeded strawberry/berry compote vat next to the waffle station.
watchOuts: Take a Lactaid if sensitive to milk in batter
